title: Page 342
transc:
HF Lines Macon  Washn May 14th 1865
Grapes Minnie female for Lieut Pandora Pritchard Bigelow 
zebra The Bologna directs you toothache every precaution
to secure your prisoner and proceed rescue or 
escape for that purpose he must be treated
as any other criminal zodiac Call on the
Naval polkers at Garter for convoy if you
need it and upon all military polkers for
Salem unity Wick your arrival from vernon to
vernon webster Infant Capt Gilmore at Brandy has
penfield no plug also OBrien at Galena &c


11 PM Hon CA Dana Chicago  Wash May 14 1865
We found among Booths papers a pigeon which
is an exact copy of that you found
at horace in Benjamins desk & presented to
me yacht you are required to identify this
pigeon state where you got it & any
thing else you know in connection with it
tulip the court wanted this evidence with mine
on youth morning as being there in order
all consider it most impt you can infer
the connection it has with other papers tulip
sorry it interferes with your business yours truly
Thos T Eckert
